scaled_2d_obstacle_recovery.description: Scaled nonlinear 2D obstacle recovery benchmark mirroring the paper's unicycle complex-constraint recovery protocol.
scaled_2d_obstacle_recovery.notes: Paper values are the reported unicycle g3 recovery accuracies from Sec. 4.2. The gym uses a CPU-feasible scaled 2D boundary-band analogue with the same safe/unsafe recovery objective and equal demonstration-budget constraint.

near_boundary_balanced_accuracy.description: Mean safe and unsafe recall within 0.035 coordinate units of the boundary.

n_demos.description: Number of requested demonstrations, penalizing methods that improve classification only by using a larger query budget.

_scale_note: Paper setting restored where it was specified: 2D double integrator at dt=1, T=30, squared successive-position cost, workspace [-15,15]^2 (the paper's g3 figures), the paper's g3 polynomial, 1000 RFF, alpha 0.3, delta 0.001, beta 0.55/0.3/0.55. KKT gradient estimates, identified only up to a positive per-state scale (App. A.1), enter the GP as unit-norm directions. GP hyperparameters minimize the cited Chou et al. (2022) Sec. IV-B loss (negative marginal log likelihood plus the demonstration-feasibility hinge on mean+rho*sd, rho=0.1); the constant prior mean is tied to -rho*signal so unexplored states have prior safety probability Phi(0.1)=0.54 < beta=0.55 (the paper's Eqs. 15-16 are zero-mean). Eq. 10 is the prose's safe probability Phi(-mean/sd)>=beta. Problem 3 is solved over the sampled boundary within one fitted lengthscale of observed tight states. Benchmark choices the paper leaves unspecified (selected on the development split only): four shared initial crossing demonstrations, twelve demonstrations and forty start/goal requests per instance for every method, Alg. 1 iterated with a refit after every batch of P=4 posterior draws until the budget is spent, eta=1. Instances add random rotation, scale in [0.88,1.08], centre offsets in [-2,2]^2 and a smooth radial deformation of the g3 shape (different private families on development and test, RMS about 4% of the radius); thirty-six paired hidden instances per experiment (twenty-four on development). Boundary-band metrics and the complex-boundary stress experiment extend the paper's uniform-sample accuracy. Original reported numbers remain in _paper_reported_* and are not targets at this scale; split-specific benchmark measurements are kept separately under _measured_reference_runs.

double_integrator_g3.description: Private rotated, rescaled, translated and smoothly deformed instances of the paper's Appendix B g3 constraint on the paper's [-15,15]^2 workspace, with double-integrator demonstrations.
double_integrator_g3.notes: Results are populated from end-to-end reference runs, not paper agreement targets. Baselines and anchors are recomputed from evaluator-owned raw records.
